from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, SdhOnsetError
for rid,n in [(6,3.2),(7,-1.2)]:
    r=open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B=r.col('magnet_field'); I=r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain
    R=r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain/I
    order=np.argsort(B); B,R=B[order],R[order]
    print(f'RUN {rid}, n={n}: complete={r.complete}, interrupted={r.interrupted}, R={R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} Ohm, I={I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA, wall={np.ptp(r.col("time")):.1f}s')
    fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(12,7))
    axs[0,0].plot(B,R);axs[0,0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Rxx (Ohm)',title=f'Run {rid}: raw signed Rxx B1-B2')
    for k in ['k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']: axs[0,1].plot(r.col('magnet_field'),r.col(k)*1e12,label=k)
    axs[0,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='gate current (pA)');axs[0,1].legend()
    try:
        on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000)
        print(on.summary())
        for t in on.tones: axs[1,0].plot(t.b_centers,t.snr,label=f'{t.freq:.1f} T')
        axs[1,0].axhline(5,color='k',ls=':');axs[1,0].legend();axs[1,0].set(xlabel='B center (T)',ylabel='tone SNR')
    except SdhOnsetError as e: print('ONSET ERROR:',e)
    for blo in [0.8,1.0,1.5,2.0]:
        for degree in [3,5]:
            f,spec=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(blo,10),bg_degree=degree,log=False,nfft=2048)
            pk,_=find_peaks(spec[0]);pk=sorted([p for p in pk if 3<f[p]<65],key=lambda p:spec[0,p],reverse=True)[:5]
            print(f'FFT B={blo}-10 degree={degree}:',[(round(float(f[p]),2),round(float(spec[0,p]),1)) for p in pk])
            if degree==5: axs[1,1].plot(f,spec[0]/max(spec[0]),label=f'{blo}-10 T')
    axs[1,1].set(xlim=(0,65),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT');axs[1,1].legend()
    fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot_run{rid}.png',dpi=140);plt.show()
PY

cat > hera_scratch/spot_verdict.md <<'EOF'
## Spot-check verdict and fan design gate

Run 6 (n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², calibrated D≈0) has peaks near 7.3, 14.8, 22.3 and 29.4 T. Their near-integer relationships are a harmonic/multiple-region confound, not four proven Fermi surfaces. Across B-window/detrender choices the ~7/15/22/30 T structure persists, while the lowest-frequency background changes. Run 7 (n=−1.2×10¹²) has clearer oscillations and an onset of 0.714 T, but the **computed full model**, not the old spot-proposal estimates, predicts ABAB 5.863/6.545 T there: their 0.682 T separation is below 2δF=1.54 T even with Bmax=10 T. A hole fan cannot cleanly count that pair at this onset. This corrects the approximate 5.3/7.1 T values in measure cell 41.

The electron side is therefore the feasible fan side despite its weaker signal: model at +3.2 predicts 7.306/25.783 T versus ABCA F_L=33.085 T. Electron onset from the default helper is spuriously censored at the coarse low-field record edge; those 50 mT samples fail Nyquist on F_L below 1 T. Restricting to B≥1 T still returns a censored 7.3 T track. Per `landau-fan`'s binding cost-floor gate, acquire one short fine low-field extension at the same density before choosing B_lo. This is in-arc `sdh-spot-check`, and prevents pricing a long fan on an aliased onset. No stacking verdict yet; the run-5 parallel CNP ridge, geometry-prior density scale, harmonics and possible adjacent-N alternatives remain live confounds.
EOF

`sdh-spot-check`, governing `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 3 and `landau-fan` cost-floor gate. Repeat only 0.3–1.5 T at n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0 with 268 uniform-1/B points (Δ1/B=0.00999 T⁻¹, >3 samples/F_L period), then choose the electron fan's B floor from the combined record. Keep 50 µV sensitivity for direct comparison, 0.3 s/24 dB lock-in settings and ≥3 s driver settle; record/plot temperatures, both gate currents and both wired lock-ins X/P.

The handoff left B≈0 and gates at zero. Preconditions re-read validators, thermometry freshness, heaters off, drive, Si, contact binding and pacing before any write. Price: total upward traverse 1.5/0.137=10.95 min plus 268×3.4 s≈15.2 min (run 6 wall 7218 s minus its 73 min bare traverse gives ≈3.1 s/point; allow extra temperature read/overhead), plus gate ramp/settle. Check first 20 points for clipping/leakage and at completion for onset; the existing 1 nA gate-current trip remains. Ends at 1.5 T and the spot gates; no temperature or Si move.
EOF
